summary: In 10.4.0, the community.vmware modules vmware_cluster, vmware_cluster_drs and vmware_cluster_vcls are deprecated for removal in community.vmware 6.0.0.
questions: When will vmware_cluster_drs and vmware_cluster_vcls be removed?

answer_card.title: community.vmware cluster module deprecations
answer_card.answer_md: `vmware_cluster`, `vmware_cluster_drs` and `vmware_cluster_vcls` are deprecated and will be removed in community.vmware 6.0.0.
